sharing.hint: Choose your WhatsApp group and tap Send. Keep the conversation there and organize the match in fulbot.
sharing.imageHint: When sharing the image, choose WhatsApp and your group. If the caption isn’t included, copy the text separately.
sharing.inviteDescription: Invite your group through WhatsApp or copy the link.
sharing.inviteMessage: Join our fulbot group to sign up for matches and see the teams:
sharing.signupNoticeDescription: Post an update in fulbot when signups open. Players who opt in also receive it on their device.
sharing.noSetup: Share invitations, announcements, teams and results from their screens. No WhatsApp account connection is needed.
sharing.advancedHint: Only for an existing compatible delivery service. Manual sharing and device notifications do not use this.
